newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close sharply up on blue chip buy.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close sharply up on blue chip buy.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed sharply higher on Thursday on foreign buying of blue chips, brokers said.
The all share index closed 17.71 points up at 706.8. Price gains led declines by 74 to eight. Aitken Spence & Co rose 7.25 rupees to 137.5, Commercial Bank ten to 195, Ceylon Tobacco 2.25 to 41.
"There is a lot of foreign interest with those who want to get in willing to buy," said Dihan Dedigama, a trader at brokerage John Keells.
He said buyers were not willing to wait for profit-taking to depress prices.
